title: Hosted CLAP and VST3 plugins receive transport, offline mode, every bus, full MIDI, and report edits and restarts

needles: CLAP latency change reaches SignalGraph latency compensation
SignalGraph hands its hosted process mode to hosted plugins at prepare
VST3 latency restart reaches SignalGraph latency compensation

installed_sdk.rationale: PluginHostSettings, PluginParameterEdit, set_plugin_host_identity and the new PluginSlot virtuals (set_host_settings, drain_parameter_edits, restart_request_count, state_change_count) are appended after every existing virtual with neutral defaults, so a downstream slot keeps its layout and behaves as before. SignalGraph gains plugin_restart_pending, apply_plugin_restarts and set_hosted_plugin_process_mode; TimelineOfflineRenderConfig gains hosted_plugin_mode, defaulting to Offline for a bounce.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command is added or altered. The headless timeline render instantiates no hosted devices, so the bounce's hosted process mode changes nothing it renders.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added, removed or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No product control, grant or policy projection is created. The change is how a host slot talks to the plugin it hosts.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time authoring capability is added or altered; the new calls are host-embedding details.
